title: E-commerce Website in Kenya: Cost, Features and What to Prepare
title_sw: Tovuti ya Biashara Mtandaoni Kenya: Gharama, Vipengele na Cha Kutayarisha
excerpt: What a KSh 120,000 Commerce package should cover, what to prepare before ordering, and how to avoid a shop that never sells.

## An online shop is a system, not a gallery

A good-looking shop is not the same as a shop that sells. In Kenya, the difference is usually practical: clear product information, a simple order path, and a reliable way for the business to receive and action enquiries.

Before you order an e-commerce site, decide what the customer should do next. Should they pay online, request a quotation, or send an order by WhatsApp? That answer changes the build more than colours or fonts do.

## What the Commerce package is for

The Commerce package starts from KSh 120,000. It is designed for a business that is ready to sell online and needs more than a brochure site. That extra work goes into product structure, order flow, and the pages that help a customer feel safe enough to buy.

This is not the package for a business that is still testing whether anyone wants the product. If you are at that stage, a simpler site with a strong enquiry path may be the smarter first step. You can upgrade later once orders are real.

## Prepare these before you order

The fastest projects are the ones where the client arrives with information ready. You do not need perfect copy. You need complete answers.

- Product names, short descriptions, prices, and clear photos
- How payment is handled, including any manual steps
- How delivery works, including areas you cover and costs
- What happens when an item is out of stock
- Who answers customer questions and within how long
- Your return or cancellation policy, even if it is short

If these answers live only in your head, the site will be delayed. Write them in a document first.

## Features that actually affect sales

Some features are useful. Others are decoration. Focus on the ones that remove friction.

Product pages should answer the basic questions before the customer has to ask. Order summaries should be clear before a customer commits. Contact and help options should be visible at the moment of doubt. On mobile, buttons must be easy to tap and the path to enquiry must be short.

A blog can support the shop by answering common questions, but it should not replace good product pages.

## Common mistakes

The first mistake is copying prices from another country without checking your own costs. The second is launching with unfinished product data. The third is treating the shop as a one-off project and forgetting that prices, stock, and delivery details change.

A shop needs an owner. Assign one person to keep the information current. That person matters more than any plugin.

## Next step

Use the Start a project button, or send a WhatsApp message to 0705 023 432 with three things: what you sell, how you take payment, and where you deliver. You will get a scoped proposal for the Commerce package.

## Duka mtandaoni ni mfumo, si picha nzuri tu

Duka linaloonekana vizuri sio sawa na duka linalouza. Nchini Kenya, tofauti mara nyingi iko kwenye maelezo ya vitendo: taarifa wazi za bidhaa, njia rahisi ya oda, na mfumo wa kuaminika wa biashara kupokea na kushughulikia maswali.

Kabla ya kuagiza tovuti ya biashara mtandaoni, amua mteja atafanya nini ifuatayo. Atalipa mtandaoni, atauliza bei, au atatuma oda kwa WhatsApp? Jibu hilo hubadilisha kazi zaidi ya rangi au fonti.

## Kifurushi cha Commerce kinafaa nini

Kifurushi cha Commerce kinaanza KSh 120,000. Kimeundwa kwa biashara iliyo tayari kuuza mtandaoni na inayohitaji zaidi ya tovuti ya matangazo. Kazi ya ziada huwekwa kwenye muundo wa bidhaa, mtiririko wa oda, na kurasa zinazomsaidia mteja kujisikia salama kufanya ununuzi.

Hiki sio kifurushi cha biashara bado inayojaribu kama kuna mtu anayetaka bidhaa. Katika hatua hiyo, tovuti rahisi yenye njia wazi ya maswali inaweza kuwa hatua bora ya kwanza. Unaweza kuboresha baadaye oda zitakapokuwa halisi.

## Tayarisha hivi kabla ya kuagiza

Miradi ya haraka ni ile ambayo mteja anakuja na taarifa tayari. Huhitaji maandishi kamili. Unahitaji majibu kamili.

- Majina ya bidhaa, maelezo mafupi, bei, na picha wazi
- Jinsi malipo yanavyofanywa, ikiwa ni pamoja na hatua za mikono
- Jinsi utoaji unavyofanya kazi, maeneo unayofikia na gharama
- Nini kinatokea bidhaa ikimalizika
- Nani anajibu maswali ya wateja na kwa muda gani
- Sera yako ya kurejesha au kughairi, hata kama ni fupi

Ikiwa majibu haya yako kichwani mwako tu, tovuti itachelewa. Yiandike kwenye hati kwanza.

## Vipengele vinavyoathiri mauzo

Baadhi ya vipengele ni muhimu. Vingine ni mapambo. Zingatia vinavyoondoa ugumu.

Kurasa za bidhaa zinapaswa kujibu maswali ya msingi kabla mteja kuuliza. Muhtasari wa oda uwe wazi kabla mteja kujitolea. Chaguo za mawasiliano na msaada zione kwenye wakati wa shaka. Kwenye simu, vitufe viwe rahisi kuguswa na njia ya kuuliza iwe fupi.

Blog inaweza kusaidia duka kwa kujibu maswali ya kawaida, lakini haipaswi kuchukua nafasi ya kurasa nzuri za bidhaa.

## Makosa ya kawaida

Kosa la kwanza ni kunakili bei za nchi nyingine bila kuzingatia gharama zako. La pili ni kuzindua duka bila taarifa kamili za bidhaa. La tatu ni kulichukulia duka kama mradi wa mara moja na kusahau kwamba bei, hisa, na maelezo ya utoaji hubadilika.

Duka linahitaji mmiliki. Mteue mtu mmoja wa kusasisha taarifa. Mtu huyo ni muhimu zaidi ya programu yoyote.

## Hatua inayofuata

Tumia kitufe cha Start a project, au tuma WhatsApp kwa 0705 023 432 ukiwa na vitu vitatu: unauza nini, unapokeaje malipo, na unatoa bidhaa wapi. Utapata pendekezo lililopangwa la kifurushi cha Commerce.
